Therefore file presence alone must not be used to infer active routing; FrankEye is historical/retained code at this head unless a specific current call site proves otherwise.

The later Drive Digital Retina learned pattern/dictionary lineage is a separate research/deployment ancestry and must be reconciled rather than silently projected onto PF frozen-head runtime.

negative_result: The first transition receipt's frozen-head FrankEye source remains valid as historical retained code evidence, but it must not be interpreted as proof that FrankEye is the active frozen-head visual route. NativeVision is the stronger current-head route evidence discovered in this follow-on shard.
